GENERAL SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)

   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

20. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

22. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash
